name: tia-portal-mcp-read
description: Explore TIA Portal projects, PLC code, hardware and public API schemas with an AI assistant.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to local TIA Portal V17, V18 or V19 through a fixed Read broker and exact-version workers. Includes project/device/PLC browsing, tag and constant queries, native cross-references where supported, hardware inspection and public API type/property/service discovery. Mutation and native content-export tools are absent. Siemens runtime DLLs are not bundled. This experimental release has build-only evidence.

tia_version.title: TIA Portal version
tia_version.description: Use auto when exactly one bundled version is installed, or enter V17, V18 or V19.
